en.summary: This one-page form, filed for respondent Luc A. Despins as Chapter 11 Trustee, states: 'I do not intend to file a response to the petition unless one is requested by the Court.' It is a procedural waiver of the present response, not consent to certiorari and not a concession on the facts or law.
en.plainEnglish: The Trustee told the Court he will not submit an opposition now unless the justices ask for one. That is like declining an optional first reply; it is not saying the petition is correct, and it does not mean the Court will hear the case.
legalReading: The form is filed on behalf of all respondents and identifies counsel for the Trustee.
The waiver is expressly conditional because a response will be filed if the Court requests one.
The form lists the Rule 15.9 corporate disclosure and unidentified-party fields as not applicable.
caseConnections: The official docket entered the waiver on August 17, 2026 and then distributed the petition for the September 28 conference.
whyItMatters: It explains why no respondent merits brief is presently available and why the petition may proceed to initial conference consideration without one.
verificationTasks: Monitor whether the Court later calls for a response; if it does, the later response supersedes any inference drawn from the waiver.
riskFlags: Do not describe the waiver as agreement, default, victory, non-opposition on the merits, or evidence that certiorari will be granted.

findings.text: The Trustee does not intend to respond unless the Court requests a response.
The waiver does not concede the petition or predict the Court's action.

zh.summary: 这份代表第 11 章受托人 Luc A. Despins 提交的一页表格写明：“除非法院要求，本人无意提交对调卷令申请的回应。”这只是放弃当前回应的程序文件，不等于同意最高法院受理，也不构成对事实或法律的承认。
zh.plainEnglish: 受托人告诉最高法院：目前不主动提交反对书，除非法官以后要求。可以把它理解成暂时不提交可选的首轮回复，不是承认申请正确，也不表示最高法院一定会审理。
legalReading: 表格表示代表全部被申请人提交，并列明受托人的律师。
放弃具有明确条件：如果最高法院要求，仍会提交回应。
表格把规则 15.9 公司披露及申请未列当事方项目填写为不适用。
caseConnections: 最高法院官方案卷于 2026 年 8 月 17 日登记该放弃书，随后把申请分发至 9 月 28 日会议。
whyItMatters: 它解释了为什么目前没有被申请人的实体回应书，以及申请为何可能在没有回应的情况下进入初次会议审议。
verificationTasks: 继续监控最高法院以后是否要求回应；一旦要求，应以之后提交的回应书为准。
riskFlags: 不得把放弃回应写成同意、缺席败诉、实体上不反对、申请方胜诉，或最高法院将准许调卷令的证据。

findings.text: 受托人表示除非最高法院要求，否则目前不提交回应。
放弃书不承认申请主张，也不能预测最高法院处理结果。
